title: Mona Patrol
description: Drive Mona across lunar craters, blast boulders, and dodge bug saucers from A to Z.

controls.action: Fire forward laser and upward anti-air cannon

instructions: Leap merge-conflict craters, blast boulders and overhead bug saucers, and reach checkpoints A to E under the 40-second par time for a sector bonus. Audio starts off; use the game's own audio, theme, and touch controls.
